#Phyloseq
```{r}
# Ensure correct object classes
taxfileS <- as.matrix(taxfileS)
mapfileS <- as.data.frame(mapfileS)
ASVsS <- as.matrix(ASVsS)

# Create phyloseq object
phy_mw <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(ASVsS, taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(taxfileS),
  sample_data(mapfileS)
)

# Remove non-bacterial contaminants and singletons
phy_mw <- phy_mw %>%
  subset_taxa(
    Kingdom == "Bacteria" &
      Family != "Mitochondria" &
      Order != "Chloroplast"
  ) %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 1, .)

# Standardize sample_type metadata
sample_data(phy_mw)$sample_type <- sample_data(phy_mw)$sample_type |>
  as.character() |>
  trimws() |>
  tolower() |>
  factor(levels = c("colon", "cloaca"))

# Save cleaned full object
saveRDS(phy_mw, file = "phy_mw_clean_full.rds")

# Extract turtle ID from sample names and subset to EI < 49
ei_num <- as.numeric(sub("^EI([0-9]+).*", "\\1", sample_names(phy_mw)))

phy_mw <- phy_mw %>%
  prune_samples(ei_num < 49, .) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .)

# Save filtered object
saveRDS(phy_mw, file = "phy_mw_pre49.rds")

phy_mw

```

#Rarifaction
```{r}

otu_mw <- otu_table(phy_mw)

otu_mw <- as.data.frame(t(as(otu_table(phy_mw), "matrix")))

sample_type <- sample_data(phy_mw)[rownames(otu_mw), "sample_type"][[1]]

cols <- ifelse(sample_type == "colon", "#0072B2", "#D55E00")

png("Figure_S2_rarefaction_colon_cloaca.png",

    width = 2400, height = 1800, res = 300)
vegan::rarecurve(
  otu_mw,
  step = 5000,
  label = FALSE,
  col = cols,
  lwd = 1.2,
  xlab = "Sequencing depth",
  ylab = "Observed ASVs"
)

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c("Colon", "Cloaca"),
  col = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"),
  lwd = 2,
  bty = "n"
)
dev.off()
# Check sequencing depth
summary(sample_sums(phy_mw))
table(sample_sums(phy_mw) < 50000)
low_depth_ids <- sample_names(phy_mw)[sample_sums(phy_mw) < 50000]
table(sample_data(phy_mw)[low_depth_ids, "sample_type"])

# Rarefy at the minimum sequencing depth to retain all samples,
# as higher thresholds would disproportionately exclude cloacal samples

set.seed(42)
rar_mw <- rarefy_even_depth(
  phy_mw,
  sample.size = 45815,
  rngseed     = 42,
  replace     = FALSE,
  verbose     = TRUE
)

# Remove taxa (ASVs) with zero counts after rarefaction
rar_mw <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rar_mw) > 0, rar_mw)

# Quick checks
rar_mw
ntaxa(rar_mw)
summary(sample_sums(rar_mw))
levels(sample_data(rar_mw)$sample_type)

# Save rarefied object
saveRDS(rar_mw, "rar_mw_pre49.rds")

### Basic info
ntaxa(phy_mw)
nsamples(phy_mw)
summary(sample_sums(phy_mw))
```

#Alpha Diversity 

```{r}

# 1. Calculate alpha-diversity metrics from rarefied data


alpha_mw <- estimate_richness(
  rar_mw,
  measures = c(
    "Observed",
    "Shannon",
    "Simpson"
  )
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_ID")


# 2. Add sample metadata

meta_mw_df <- as(
  sample_data(rar_mw),
  "data.frame"
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_ID")


alpha_mw_df <- alpha_mw %>%
  left_join(
    meta_mw_df,
    by = "sample_ID"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    sample_type %in% c(
      "colon",
      "cloaca"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleType = factor(
      as.character(sample_type),
      levels = c(
        "colon",
        "cloaca"
      )
    ),
    turtle_ID = factor(
      as.character(turtle_ID)
    )
  )

# 3. Confirm paired structure and retain complete pairs

pair_check <- alpha_mw_df %>%
  count(
    turtle_ID,
    SampleType
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = SampleType,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )


complete_pair_ids <- pair_check %>%
  filter(
    colon == 1,
    cloaca == 1
  ) %>%
  pull(turtle_ID)


alpha_mw_df <- alpha_mw_df %>%
  filter(
    turtle_ID %in% complete_pair_ids
  )


cat(
  "Number of complete turtle pairs:",
  length(complete_pair_ids),
  "\n"
)

print(
  table(alpha_mw_df$SampleType)
)


stopifnot(
  length(complete_pair_ids) > 0,
  all(
    c("colon", "cloaca") %in%
      levels(alpha_mw_df$SampleType)
  )
)


# 4. Create wide table for paired statistical testing

alpha_wide <- alpha_mw_df %>%
  select(
    turtle_ID,
    SampleType,
    Observed,
    Shannon,
    Simpson
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = SampleType,
    values_from = c(
      Observed,
      Shannon,
      Simpson
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na()


cat(
  "Complete pairs used in statistical tests:",
  nrow(alpha_wide),
  "\n"
)


# 5. Create long table for plotting and summaries

metric_levels <- c(
  "Observed",
  "Shannon",
  "Simpson"
)


alpha_long <- alpha_mw_df %>%
  select(
    sample_ID,
    turtle_ID,
    SampleType,
    all_of(metric_levels)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(metric_levels),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(
      Metric,
      levels = metric_levels
    )
  )


# 6. Calculate medians, quartiles and IQRs

alpha_summary <- alpha_long %>%
  group_by(
    Metric,
    SampleType
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(Value)),
    
    Median = median(
      Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    Q1 = stats::quantile(
      Value,
      probs = 0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    
    Q3 = stats::quantile(
      Value,
      probs = 0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    
    IQR = stats::IQR(
      Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )


print(alpha_summary)



# 7. Function for paired Wilcoxon tests and effect sizes
#   +1 = all non-zero paired differences favour cloaca
#   -1 = all non-zero paired differences favour colon


paired_alpha_summary <- function(
    colon_values,
    cloaca_values,
    metric_name
) {
  
  keep <- complete.cases(
    colon_values,
    cloaca_values
  )
  
  colon_values <- colon_values[keep]
  cloaca_values <- cloaca_values[keep]
  
  paired_difference <-
    cloaca_values - colon_values
  
  nonzero_difference <-
    paired_difference[
      paired_difference != 0
    ]
  
  if (length(nonzero_difference) == 0) {
    
    rank_biserial <- 0
    
  } else {
    
    signed_ranks <- rank(
      abs(nonzero_difference),
      ties.method = "average"
    )
    
    positive_rank_sum <- sum(
      signed_ranks[
        nonzero_difference > 0
      ]
    )
    
    negative_rank_sum <- sum(
      signed_ranks[
        nonzero_difference < 0
      ]
    )
    
    rank_biserial <- (
      positive_rank_sum -
        negative_rank_sum
    ) / (
      positive_rank_sum +
        negative_rank_sum
    )
  }
  
  wilcox_output <- wilcox.test(
    x = cloaca_values,
    y = colon_values,
    paired = TRUE,
    exact = FALSE,
    alternative = "two.sided"
  )
  
  tibble(
    Metric = metric_name,
    n_pairs = length(colon_values),
    
    Colon_median = median(
      colon_values,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Colon_Q1 = quantile(
      colon_values,
      0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    Colon_Q3 = quantile(
      colon_values,
      0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    Colon_IQR = IQR(
      colon_values,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    Cloaca_median = median(
      cloaca_values,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Cloaca_Q1 = quantile(
      cloaca_values,
      0.25,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    Cloaca_Q3 = quantile(
      cloaca_values,
      0.75,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    ),
    Cloaca_IQR = IQR(
      cloaca_values,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    
    Median_paired_difference =
      median(
        paired_difference,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    Wilcoxon_V =
      unname(
        wilcox_output$statistic
      ),
    
    p_value =
      wilcox_output$p.value,
    
    Rank_biserial =
      rank_biserial
  )
}


# 8. Run paired tests for all metrics

alpha_stats <- bind_rows(
  
  paired_alpha_summary(
    colon_values =
      alpha_wide$Observed_colon,
    cloaca_values =
      alpha_wide$Observed_cloaca,
    metric_name =
      "Observed"
  ),
  
  paired_alpha_summary(
    colon_values =
      alpha_wide$Shannon_colon,
    cloaca_values =
      alpha_wide$Shannon_cloaca,
    metric_name =
      "Shannon"
  ),
  
  paired_alpha_summary(
    colon_values =
      alpha_wide$Simpson_colon,
    cloaca_values =
      alpha_wide$Simpson_cloaca,
    metric_name =
      "Simpson"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    BH_adjusted_p = p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    
    Significance = case_when(
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.001  ~ "***",
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.01   ~ "**",
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE                   ~ "ns"
    ),
    
    Effect_magnitude = case_when(
      abs(Rank_biserial) < 0.10 ~
        "Negligible",
      
      abs(Rank_biserial) < 0.30 ~
        "Small",
      
      abs(Rank_biserial) < 0.50 ~
        "Moderate",
      
      TRUE ~
        "Large"
    ),
    
    Effect_direction = case_when(
      Rank_biserial > 0 ~
        "Higher in cloaca",
      
      Rank_biserial < 0 ~
        "Higher in colon",
      
      TRUE ~
        "No directional effect"
    )
  )


print(alpha_stats)


# 9. Save paired differences for each turtle

alpha_paired_differences <- alpha_wide %>%
  transmute(
    turtle_ID,
    
    Observed_colon,
    Observed_cloaca,
    Observed_difference =
      Observed_cloaca -
      Observed_colon,
    
    Shannon_colon,
    Shannon_cloaca,
    Shannon_difference =
      Shannon_cloaca -
      Shannon_colon,
    
    Simpson_colon,
    Simpson_cloaca,
    Simpson_difference =
      Simpson_cloaca -
      Simpson_colon
  )


# 10. Prepare BH-adjusted figure annotations

annotation_df <- alpha_long %>%
  group_by(Metric) %>%
  summarise(
    value_min = min(
      Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    value_max = max(
      Value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    value_range =
      value_max - value_min,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value_range = if_else(
      value_range == 0,
      abs(value_max) * 0.10 + 0.01,
      value_range
    ),
    
    y_position =
      value_max +
      0.10 * value_range
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    alpha_stats %>%
      transmute(
        Metric = factor(
          Metric,
          levels = metric_levels
        ),
        Significance,
        BH_adjusted_p
      ),
    by = "Metric"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    annotation_label = case_when(
      BH_adjusted_p < 0.001 ~
        paste0(
          Significance,
          "\nBH p < 0.001"
        ),
      
      TRUE ~
        paste0(
          Significance,
          "\nBH p = ",
          formatC(
            BH_adjusted_p,
            format = "f",
            digits = 3
          )
        )
    )
  )


print(annotation_df)
```

#Beta Diversity
##Aitchision
```{r}
##  Aitchison distance (CLR-transformed ASV table)

# Subset to colon and cloaca samples only
phy_beta_mw <- phy_mw %>%
  subset_samples(sample_type %in% c("colon", "cloaca")) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .)

# Basic checks
stopifnot(sum(is.na(sample_data(phy_beta_mw)$sample_type)) == 0)
stopifnot(nsamples(phy_beta_mw) == 96)

# CLR transform
phy_beta_mw_clr <- transform(phy_beta_mw, "clr")

# Extract CLR matrix (samples × ASVs)
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(phy_beta_mw_clr), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(phy_beta_mw_clr)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

stopifnot(identical(rownames(otu_mat), sample_names(phy_beta_mw_clr)))

# Aitchison distance
dist_aitch_mw <- dist(otu_mat, method = "euclidean")

# Metadata
meta_mw <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_beta_mw_clr))

# PERMANOVA (paired design blocked by turtle_ID)
set.seed(42)
adonis_aitch_mw <- adonis2(
  dist_aitch_mw ~ sample_type,
  data = meta_mw,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = meta_mw$turtle_ID
)

adonis_aitch_mw

# Homogeneity of dispersion
set.seed(42)
disp_aitch_mw <- betadisper(dist_aitch_mw, meta_mw$sample_type)
permutest(disp_aitch_mw, permutations = 999)
anova(disp_aitch_mw)

## PCA for visualization
ord <- prcomp(otu_mat, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
eig <- ord$sdev^2 / sum(ord$sdev^2) * 100

# Clean sample type labels
clean_sample_type <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("\u00A0", " ") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%
    trimws() %>%
    tolower()
}

# Sample scores
df_plot <- data.frame(
  sample_ID = rownames(otu_mat),
  turtle_ID = meta_mw$turtle_ID,
  PC1 = ord$x[, 1],
  PC2 = ord$x[, 2],
  sample_type = meta_mw$sample_type
) %>%
  mutate(
    SampleType = factor(
      clean_sample_type(sample_type),
      levels = c("colon", "cloaca")
    )
  )

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(nrow(df_plot) == 96)
stopifnot(sum(is.na(df_plot$SampleType)) == 0)

# PCA loadings
loadings <- as.data.frame(ord$rotation) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV")

tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_beta_mw_clr)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV")

# Select top genus/family drivers
top_taxa <- loadings %>%
  left_join(tax, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    Genus  = ifelse(tolower(Genus) %in% c("unclassified", "unknown", ""), NA, Genus),
    Family = ifelse(tolower(Family) %in% c("unclassified", "unknown", ""), NA, Family),
    label  = ifelse(!is.na(Genus), Genus, Family),
    label  = stringr::str_replace_all(label, "_", " ")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(label)) %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(PC1), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(PC1))) %>%
  slice(1:6)

# Scale arrows for plotting
arrow_mult <- quantile(abs(c(df_plot$PC1, df_plot$PC2)), 0.9) * 8

top_taxa <- top_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    PC1_plot = PC1 * arrow_mult,
    PC2_plot = PC2 * arrow_mult
  )

# Plot
p_MW <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(colour = SampleType),
    type = "t",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = SampleType),
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = top_taxa,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1_plot, yend = PC2_plot),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    colour = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = top_taxa,
    aes(x = PC1_plot, y = PC2_plot, label = label),
    size = 3.8,
    fontface = "italic",
    box.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = NA,
    bg.color = "white",
    bg.r = 0.15,
    max.overlaps = 50,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "colon"  = "#009E73",
      "cloaca" = "#7B4EA3"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    title = "Aitchison PCA of Wild Maldives Sea Turtles",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(eig[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(eig[2], 1), "%)"),
    colour = "Sample type"
  )

p_MW

# Save figure
ggsave(
  "MW_Aitchison_PCA_colon_vs_cloaca_genus_loadings.png",
  p_MW,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "MW_Aitchison_PCA_colon_vs_cloaca_genus_loadings.svg",
  p_MW,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  device = "svg"
)

# Save loading tables
loading_table <- loadings %>%
  left_join(tax, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus),
    abs_PC1 = abs(PC1),
    abs_PC2 = abs(PC2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_PC1)) %>%
  select(ASV, Genus, Family, PC1, PC2, abs_PC1, abs_PC2)

write.csv(
  loading_table,
  "MW_Aitchison_PCA_Genus_Loadings.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  loading_table %>% slice(1:20),
  "MW_Aitchison_PCA_Top20_Genus_Loadings.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
phy_phylum <- phy_mw %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Phylum", NArm = FALSE)

# Convert to relative abundance
phy_phylum_rel <- transform_sample_counts(phy_phylum, function(x) x / sum(x))

# Melt to long format and clean labels
df_phylum <- psmelt(phy_phylum_rel) %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = as.character(Phylum),
    Phylum = ifelse(is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "", "Unclassified", Phylum),
    sample_type = tolower(trimws(as.character(sample_type)))
  )

## Color palette
base_pastel <- c(
  "#9AD0EC", "#FBC4AB", "#B5EAD7", "#FFAFCC", "#CDB4DB",
  "#E4C1F9", "#FFF1A8", "#CED4DA", "#BEE7E8", "#FFD6A5",
  "#CAFFBF", "#FDFFB6", "#FFC6FF", "#BDB2FF", "#EAE4E9",
  "#F1FAEE", "#E9C46A", "#F4A261", "#84A59D", "#B8F2E6"
)

## Top phyla for plotting
topN <- 10

top_phyla <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(mean_abund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abund)) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  pull(Phylum)

df_phylum <- df_phylum %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum_plot = ifelse(Phylum %in% top_phyla, Phylum, "Other")
  )

phyla_levels <- sort(unique(df_phylum$Phylum_plot))
phyla_levels <- phyla_levels[phyla_levels != "Other"]

phyla_colors <- setNames(
  base_pastel[seq_along(phyla_levels)],
  phyla_levels
)

phyla_colors <- c(phyla_colors, Other = "grey85")
phyla_colors["Pseudomonadota"] <- "#8DA0CB"

## Mean composition by sample type

  summarise(Abundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

ggsave(

## Per-sample composition

## Export phylum summary tables
top_phyla_tables <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(sample_type, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abundance = sd(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples = sum(!is.na(Abundance)),
    se_abundance = sd_abundance / sqrt(n_samples),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_abundance), .by_group = TRUE) %>%

  top_phyla_tables,

## Paired Wilcoxon tests by phylum
df_phylum_clean <- df_phylum %>%
  group_by(turtle_ID, sample_type, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

df_phylum_wide <- df_phylum_clean %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = Abundance
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(colon) & !is.na(cloaca))

phylum_wilcox_results <- lapply(unique(df_phylum_wide$Phylum), function(p) {
  sub <- df_phylum_wide[df_phylum_wide$Phylum == p, ]

  test <- wilcox.test(
    sub$colon,
    sub$cloaca,
    paired = TRUE
  )

  data.frame(
    Phylum = p,
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

phylum_wilcox_results$p_adj <- p.adjust(phylum_wilcox_results$p_value, method = "BH")

phylum_means <- df_phylum_clean %>%
  group_by(sample_type, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(mean_abundance = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = sample_type, values_from = mean_abundance)

phylum_stats <- phylum_wilcox_results %>%
  left_join(phylum_means, by = "Phylum") %>%
  mutate(
    higher_in = ifelse(colon > cloaca, "colon", "cloaca")
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

phylum_stats

writexl::write_xlsx(
  phylum_stats,
  "MW_Wild_Phyla_Paired_Wilcoxon.xlsx"
)

#Merge tables
# Reshape abundance summary table to wide format
phylum_summary_wide <- top_phyla_tables %>%
  select(sample_type, Phylum, mean_abundance, sd_abundance, se_abundance) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = c(mean_abundance, sd_abundance, se_abundance)
  )

# Merge summary abundances with paired Wilcoxon results
phylum_supp_table <- phylum_summary_wide %>%
  left_join(
    phylum_stats %>%
      select(Phylum, p_value, p_adj, higher_in),
    by = "Phylum"
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adj)

# View merged table
phylum_supp_table

# Save merged supplementary table
write.csv(
  phylum_supp_table,
  "MW_SuppTable_Phyla_Abundance_and_Wilcoxon.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

writexl::write_xlsx(
  phylum_supp_table,
  "MW_SuppTable_Phyla_Abundance_and_Wilcoxon.xlsx"
)
```

##Genus
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1. Prepare genus-level data
# -----------------------------
topN <- 30

phy_genus_rel <- phy_mw %>%
  subset_samples(sample_type %in% c("colon", "cloaca")) %>%
  prune_samples(sample_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 0, .) %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE) %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) x / sum(x))

df_genus <- psmelt(phy_genus_rel) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = as.character(Genus),
    Genus = if_else(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus),
    sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = c("colon", "cloaca"))
  )


# 2. Summary stats + Wilcoxon 

# agglomaerat per turtle
df_genus_clean <- df_genus %>%
  group_by(turtle_ID, sample_type, Genus) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop")

# Summary stats (mean ± SE)
genus_summary <- df_genus_clean %>%
  group_by(sample_type, Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abundance = mean(Abundance),
    sd_abundance   = sd(Abundance),
    n_samples      = n(),
    se_abundance   = sd_abundance / sqrt(n_samples),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_pct = mean_abundance * 100,
    se_pct   = se_abundance * 100
  )

# Pivot summary to wide (colon vs cloaca side-by-side)
genus_summary_wide <- genus_summary %>%
  select(sample_type, Genus, mean_pct, se_pct) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = c(mean_pct, se_pct)
  )

# -----------------------------
# Paired Wilcoxon
# -----------------------------
df_genus_wide <- df_genus_clean %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = sample_type,
    values_from = Abundance
  ) %>%
  drop_na(colon, cloaca)

genus_wilcox <- df_genus_wide %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    test <- wilcox.test(.x$colon, .x$cloaca, paired = TRUE)
    tibble(p_value = test$p.value)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))

# Mean values for direction + effect size
genus_means <- df_genus_wide %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    colon = mean(colon),
    cloaca = mean(cloaca),
    mean_diff = abs(colon - cloaca),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    higher_in = if_else(colon > cloaca, "colon", "cloaca")
  )


# final table
genus_final <- genus_summary_wide %>%
  left_join(genus_wilcox, by = "Genus") %>%
  left_join(genus_means, by = "Genus") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_diff))

# Top 50 + All genera

top50_genera <- genus_final %>%
  slice_head(n = 50)


# Export
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    Top50 = top50_genera,
    All_genera = genus_final
  ),
  "MW_Genus_Final_COLON_vs_CLOACA.xlsx"
)

```



#ANCOM
## Paired ANCOM ASV level
```{r}

# Paired ANCOM-BC2 analysis:
# Reference level: cloaca
# lfc_sample_typecolon:  positive = colon-enriched  negative = cloaca-enriched


# 1. subset


phy_asv <- phy_mw %>%
  subset_samples(
    species == "EI" &
      grepl("^wild", status, ignore.case = TRUE) &
      sample_type %in% c("colon", "cloaca") &
      !is.na(sample_type) &
      !is.na(turtle_ID)
  )

phy_asv <- prune_samples(
  sample_sums(phy_asv) > 0,
  phy_asv
)

phy_asv <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_asv) > 0,
  phy_asv
)



# 2. set factors

sample_data(phy_asv)$sample_type <- factor(
  as.character(sample_data(phy_asv)$sample_type),
  levels = c("cloaca", "colon")
)

sample_data(phy_asv)$turtle_ID <- factor(
  as.character(sample_data(phy_asv)$turtle_ID)
)


# 3. Confirm each turtle has colon and cloaca sample


pair_table <- table(
  sample_data(phy_asv)$turtle_ID,
  sample_data(phy_asv)$sample_type
)

print(pair_table)

complete_pairs <- rownames(pair_table)[
  pair_table[, "cloaca"] == 1 &
    pair_table[, "colon"] == 1
]

cat(
  "\nNumber of complete turtle pairs:",
  length(complete_pairs),
  "\n"
)

cat("Samples retained:", nsamples(phy_asv), "\n")
cat("ASVs before ANCOM-BC2 filtering:", ntaxa(phy_asv), "\n")
print(table(sample_data(phy_asv)$sample_type))

# 4. paired ANCOM-BC2
# sample_type = fixed effect
# turtle_ID   = random intercept

set.seed(123)

ancom_asv <- ancombc2(
  data = phy_asv,
  assay_name = "otu_table",
  tax_level = NULL,
  fix_formula = "sample_type",
  rand_formula = "(1 | turtle_ID)",
  group = "sample_type",
  p_adj_method = "BH",
  prv_cut = 0.10,
  lib_cut = 1000,
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = TRUE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  verbose = TRUE
)

# Save object
saveRDS(
  ancom_asv,
  "ANCOMBC2_paired_colon_vs_cloaca_model.rds"
)


# 5. Extract modeled ANCOM-BC2 results


                # Verify columns
required_columns <- c(
  
  "taxon",
  
  "lfc_sample_typecolon",
  
  "se_sample_typecolon",
  
  "p_sample_typecolon",
  
  "q_sample_typecolon",
  
  "passed_ss_sample_typecolon",
  
  "diff_sample_typecolon",
  
  "diff_robust_sample_typecolon"
  
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  
  required_columns,
  
  colnames(ancom_asv$res)
  
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  
  stop(
    
    "Missing expected result columns: ",
    
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    
  )
  
}

           # extract results

required_columns <- c(
  "taxon",
  "lfc_sample_typecolon",
  "se_sample_typecolon",
  "p_sample_typecolon",
  "q_sample_typecolon",
  "passed_ss_sample_typecolon",
  "diff_sample_typecolon",
  "diff_robust_sample_typecolon"
)

missing_columns <- setdiff(
  required_columns,
  colnames(ancom_asv$res)
)

if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing expected result columns: ",
    paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

res_asv <- ancom_asv$res %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  transmute(
    ASV = as.character(taxon),
    logFC = lfc_sample_typecolon,
    se = se_sample_typecolon,
    p_val = p_sample_typecolon,
    q_val = q_sample_typecolon,
    passed_ss = passed_ss_sample_typecolon,
    diff_abn = diff_sample_typecolon,
    diff_robust = diff_robust_sample_typecolon
  )



# 6. Attach taxonomy 

tax_df <- as.data.frame(
  tax_table(phy_asv),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV")

res_asv <- res_asv %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      any_of(c("Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus")),
      ~na_if(as.character(.x), "Unclassified")
    ),
    Label = case_when(
      !is.na(Genus) & Genus != "" ~
        paste0(Genus, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      !is.na(Family) & Family != "" ~
        paste0("Unclassified ", Family, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      !is.na(Order) & Order != "" ~
        paste0("Unclassified ", Order, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      !is.na(Class) & Class != "" ~
        paste0("Unclassified ", Class, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      !is.na(Phylum) & Phylum != "" ~
        paste0("Unclassified ", Phylum, " (", ASV, ")"),
      
      TRUE ~ ASV
    ),
    
    # Direction depends only on coefficient sign.
    direction = case_when(
      logFC > 0 ~ "Colon-enriched",
      logFC < 0 ~ "Cloaca-enriched",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )



# 7. Create result set containing significant after BH and robust sensitivity (ANCOM SS FILTER)


# BH-significant modeled ASVs
sig_asv <- res_asv %>%
  filter(
    diff_abn %in% TRUE,
    !is.na(logFC)
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_val)

# Significant ASVs that also pass pseudo-count sensitivity
sig_asv_robust <- res_asv %>%
  filter(
    diff_robust %in% TRUE,
    !is.na(logFC)
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_val)



# 8. Summarize results

cat("\nASVs modeled:", nrow(res_asv), "\n")
cat("BH-significant modeled ASVs:", nrow(sig_asv), "\n")
cat(
  "Pseudo-count-robust significant ASVs:",
  nrow(sig_asv_robust),
  "\n"
)

cat("\nBH-significant ASVs by direction:\n")
print(sig_asv %>% count(direction))

cat("\nRobust significant ASVs by direction:\n")
print(sig_asv_robust %>% count(direction))


# 9. Extract structural-zero ASVs (many of them might be bioloigcal important as they are almost absent in one of the sample types)


zero_asv <- ancom_asv$zero_ind %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    ASV = as.character(taxon),
    
    direction = case_when(
      `structural_zero (sample_type = cloaca)` %in% TRUE &
        !(`structural_zero (sample_type = colon)` %in% TRUE) ~
        "Colon-associated",
      
      `structural_zero (sample_type = colon)` %in% TRUE &
        !(`structural_zero (sample_type = cloaca)` %in% TRUE) ~
        "Cloaca-associated",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction)) %>%
  select(-taxon) %>%
  left_join(tax_df, by = "ASV")

cat("\nStructural-zero ASVs by direction:\n")
print(zero_asv %>% count(direction))


# 10. Add prevalence and abundance to structural zeros to determine the most important ones 
# Subset to structural-zero ASVs before converting to long format to reduce memory use.


otu_zero <- as(
  otu_table(phy_asv),
  "matrix"
)

if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_asv)) {
  otu_zero <- t(otu_zero)
}

zero_ids <- intersect(
  zero_asv$ASV,
  rownames(otu_zero)
)

otu_zero <- otu_zero[zero_ids, , drop = FALSE]

meta_zero <- data.frame(
  sample_data(phy_asv),
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_name")

zero_counts_long <- as.data.frame(otu_zero) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ASV,
    names_to = "sample_name",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    meta_zero %>%
      select(
        sample_name,
        turtle_ID,
        sample_type
      ),
    by = "sample_name"
  )

zero_summary <- zero_counts_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, sample_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples = n(),
    n_detected = sum(count > 0),
    prevalence = mean(count > 0),
    mean_count = mean(count),
    median_count = median(count),
    total_count = sum(count),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = c(
      n_samples,
      n_detected,
      prevalence,
      mean_count,
      median_count,
      total_count
    ),
    names_sep = "_"
  )

zero_asv_full <- zero_asv %>%
  left_join(zero_summary, by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(
    prevalence_present_group = case_when(
      direction == "Colon-associated" ~ prevalence_colon,
      direction == "Cloaca-associated" ~ prevalence_cloaca,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    mean_count_present_group = case_when(
      direction == "Colon-associated" ~ mean_count_colon,
      direction == "Cloaca-associated" ~ mean_count_cloaca,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    total_count_present_group = case_when(
      direction == "Colon-associated" ~ total_count_colon,
      direction == "Cloaca-associated" ~ total_count_cloaca,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )



# 11. Rank structural-zero ASVs as they do not have p values


top_structural_zero <- zero_asv_full %>%
  arrange(
    desc(prevalence_present_group),
    desc(mean_count_present_group)
  )

top_structural_zero_by_direction <- zero_asv_full %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(prevalence_present_group),
    desc(mean_count_present_group),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

print(
  top_structural_zero %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      Genus,
      direction,
      prevalence_cloaca,
      prevalence_colon,
      mean_count_cloaca,
      mean_count_colon
    ) %>%
    head(20)
)


# 12. Export complete supplementary table with ancom and structural zero results


write_xlsx(
  list(
    All_modelled_ASVs = res_asv,
    Significant_modelled_ASVs = sig_asv,
    Robust_significant_ASVs = sig_asv_robust,
    All_structural_zero_ASVs = zero_asv_full,
    Top_structural_zeros = top_structural_zero,
    Top_10_zeros_by_direction =
      top_structural_zero_by_direction
  ),
  "ANCOMBC2_paired_colon_vs_cloaca_complete.xlsx"
)


############################################
# 13. Select ASVs for Figure 3C
#
# 4 modeled ASVs per direction = 8 bars
# 2 structural-zero ASVs per direction = 4 diamonds
# Total = 12 ASVs


# 13A. Select ANCOM model ASVs:  Rank by absolute estimated log fold change.


modelled_for_figure <- sig_asv_robust %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(logFC),
    !is.na(direction)
  ) %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = abs(logFC),
    n = 4,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    result_type = "Robust estimated logFC",
    plot_direction = direction,
    plot_value = logFC,
    Plot_label = Label
  )



# 13B. Select structural-zero ASVs
#Rank first by prevalence, then by mean abundance

zero_for_figure <- zero_asv_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction)) %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(prevalence_present_group),
    desc(mean_count_present_group),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    plot_direction = recode(
      direction,
      "Colon-associated" = "Colon-enriched",
      "Cloaca-associated" = "Cloaca-enriched"
    ),
    
    Plot_label = case_when(
      !is.na(Genus) & Genus != "" ~
        paste0(Genus, " (", ASV, "; SZ)"),
      
      !is.na(Family) & Family != "" ~
        paste0(
          "Unclassified ",
          Family,
          " (",
          ASV,
          "; SZ)"
        ),
      
      TRUE ~ paste0(ASV, " (SZ)")
    ),
    
    result_type = "Structural zero"
  )



# 14. Define structural-zero marker positions
# Structural-zero markers are placed just outside the modeled logFC range. Their position indicates direction, not numerical effect size.


max_abs_logFC <- max(
  abs(modelled_for_figure$logFC),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

structural_zero_position <- max_abs_logFC * 1.15

zero_for_figure <- zero_for_figure %>%
  mutate(
    plot_value = case_when(
      plot_direction == "Colon-enriched" ~
        structural_zero_position,
      
      plot_direction == "Cloaca-enriched" ~
        -structural_zero_position,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )


# 15. Create shared row order


plot_order <- bind_rows(
  modelled_for_figure %>%
    select(
      Plot_label,
      plot_value
    ),
  
  zero_for_figure %>%
    select(
      Plot_label,
      plot_value
    )
) %>%
  arrange(plot_value)

label_levels <- plot_order$Plot_label

modelled_for_figure <- modelled_for_figure %>%
  mutate(
    Plot_label = factor(
      Plot_label,
      levels = label_levels
    )
  )

zero_for_figure <- zero_for_figure %>%
  mutate(
    Plot_label = factor(
      Plot_label,
      levels = label_levels
    )
  )



# 16. Plot combined ANCOM-BC2 results
# Bars:
#   modeled ASVs with estimated log fold changes
# Diamonds:
#   structural-zero ASVs; position shows direction only


p_ancom_asv <- ggplot() +
  
  geom_col(
    data = modelled_for_figure,
    aes(
      x = plot_value,
      y = Plot_label,
      fill = plot_direction
    ),
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = zero_for_figure,
    aes(
      x = plot_value,
      y = Plot_label,
      fill = plot_direction
    ),
    shape = 23,
    size = 4,
    stroke = 0.8,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Colon-enriched" = "#4E8B5C",
      "Cloaca-enriched" = "#7B1FA2"
    ),
    na.translate = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(
      -structural_zero_position * 1.08,
      structural_zero_position * 1.08
    ),
    breaks = pretty(
      c(-max_abs_logFC, max_abs_logFC),
      n = 5
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title =
      "Differentially abundant ASVs between colon and cloaca",
    
    subtitle = expression(
      paste(
        "Paired ANCOM-BC2 analysis of wild ",
        italic("E. imbricata")
      )
    ),
    
    x = "Log fold change (colon relative to cloaca)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_ancom_asv)


# 17. Save Figure 3C draft


ggsave(
  filename =
    "ANCOMBC2_paired_colon_vs_cloaca_8modeled_4SZ.png",
  plot = p_ancom_asv,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename =
    "ANCOMBC2_paired_colon_vs_cloaca_8modeled_4SZ.svg",
  plot = p_ancom_asv,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  bg = "white"
)


# Verify plotted taxa are also passed SS filter /  robust sensitivity
modelled_for_figure %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    Label,
    logFC,
    q_val,
    passed_ss,
    diff_robust
  )

table(modelled_for_figure$diff_robust)


# 18. Save data displayed in Figure 3C


figure3c_data <- bind_rows(
  modelled_for_figure %>%
    transmute(
```

# Venn Diagram 
```{r}
# Use same filtered phyloseq object as ANCOM
otu <- as(otu_table(phy_asv), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_asv)) otu <- t(otu)

meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(phy_asv))

colon_samples  <- rownames(meta)[meta$sample_type == "colon"]
cloaca_samples <- rownames(meta)[meta$sample_type == "cloaca"]

# ASVs present at least once in each sample type
colon_asvs <- rownames(otu)[
  rowSums(otu[, colon_samples, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0
]

cloaca_asvs <- rownames(otu)[
  rowSums(otu[, cloaca_samples, drop = FALSE] > 0) > 0
]

# Counts
shared      <- intersect(colon_asvs, cloaca_asvs)
colon_only  <- setdiff(colon_asvs, cloaca_asvs)
cloaca_only <- setdiff(cloaca_asvs, colon_asvs)

n_colon_only  <- length(colon_only)
n_cloaca_only <- length(cloaca_only)
n_shared      <- length(shared)
total_asvs    <- length(union(colon_asvs, cloaca_asvs))

pct <- function(x) paste0(round(x / total_asvs * 100, 1), "%")

# Check numbers
data.frame(
  Category = c("Colon only", "Shared", "Cloaca only", "Total"),
  n_ASVs = c(n_colon_only, n_shared, n_cloaca_only, total_asvs),
  Percent = c(pct(n_colon_only), pct(n_shared), pct(n_cloaca_only), "100%")
)

# Manual Venn-style plot
p_venn <- ggplot() +
  # Cloaca circle: larger/top/purple
  geom_circle(
    aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0.45, r = 1.25),
    fill = "#D8C7F0",
    color = "#7B1FA2",
    alpha = 0.55,
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  # Colon circle: smaller/bottom/green
  geom_circle(
    aes(x0 = 0, y0 = -0.55, r = 0.95),
    fill = "#CFE8D6",
    color = "#4E8B5C",
    alpha = 0.55,
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 1.9, label = "Cloaca",
           color = "#7B1FA2", fontface = "bold", size = 7) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = -1.65, label = "Colon",
           color = "#4E8B5C", fontface = "bold", size = 7) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.95,
           label = paste0(n_cloaca_only, "\n(", pct(n_cloaca_only), ")"),
           size = 5.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = -0.05,
           label = paste0(n_shared, "\n(", pct(n_shared), ")"),
           size = 5.5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = -1.0,
           label = paste0(n_colon_only, "\n(", pct(n_colon_only), ")"),
           size = 5.5) +
  labs(
    title = "ASV overlap between colon and cloacal samples",
    subtitle = paste0("Presence/absence of ASVs; total ASVs = ", total_asvs)
  ) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(-1.8, 1.8), ylim = c(-2.0, 2.2)) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 13)
  )

p_venn

ggsave(
  "ASV_overlap_colon_cloaca_venn.png",
  p_venn,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "ASV_overlap_colon_cloaca_venn.svg",
  p_venn,
  width = 7,
  height = 6,
  bg = "white"
)
```

##Comment 4:Sensitivity Analysis Alpha/Beta stats to compare samples from 2023 and 2024
```{r}
#1. ALPHA DIVERSITY 

# Add sampling year to rarefied phyloseq object
sample_data(rar_mw)$year <- ifelse(
  as.numeric(
    sub("^EI([0-9]+).*", "\\1", sample_names(rar_mw))
  ) <= 29,
  "2023",
  "2024"
)

sample_data(rar_mw)$year <- factor(
  sample_data(rar_mw)$year,
  levels = c("2023", "2024")
)

# Split rarefied object by year
rar_2023 <- subset_samples(rar_mw, year == "2023")
rar_2024 <- subset_samples(rar_mw, year == "2024")

# Remove taxa absent within each year subset
rar_2023 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rar_2023) > 0, rar_2023)
rar_2024 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rar_2024) > 0, rar_2024)

# Estimate alpha diversity
alpha_2023 <- estimate_richness(
  rar_2023,
  measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")
)

alpha_2024 <- estimate_richness(
  rar_2024,
  measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")
)

# Add metadata
alpha_2023$sample_type <- as.character(
  sample_data(rar_2023)$sample_type
)
alpha_2023$turtle_ID <- as.character(
  sample_data(rar_2023)$turtle_ID
)

alpha_2024$sample_type <- as.character(
  sample_data(rar_2024)$sample_type
)
alpha_2024$turtle_ID <- as.character(
  sample_data(rar_2024)$turtle_ID
)

# Metrics to test
metrics <- c("Observed", "Shannon", "Simpson")

# Paired Wilcoxon: 2023
results_2023 <- lapply(metrics, function(metric) {

  wide <- alpha_2023 %>%
    dplyr::select(
      turtle_ID,
      sample_type,
      dplyr::all_of(metric)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = sample_type,
      values_from = dplyr::all_of(metric)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(colon, cloaca)

  test <- wilcox.test(
    wide$colon,
    wide$cloaca,
    paired = TRUE
  )

  data.frame(
    Metric = metric,
    n_pairs = nrow(wide),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    BH = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  )

# Paired Wilcoxon: 2024
results_2024 <- lapply(metrics, function(metric) {

  wide <- alpha_2024 %>%
    dplyr::select(
      turtle_ID,
      sample_type,
      dplyr::all_of(metric)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = sample_type,
      values_from = dplyr::all_of(metric)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(colon, cloaca)

  test <- wilcox.test(
    wide$colon,
    wide$cloaca,
    paired = TRUE
  )

  data.frame(
    Metric = metric,
    n_pairs = nrow(wide),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    BH = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")
  )

# Combine results
alpha_year_results <- bind_rows(
  results_2023 %>% mutate(Year = "2023"),
  results_2024 %>% mutate(Year = "2024")
) %>%
  select(
```

##Comment 5: Sequencing summary table
```{r}

# 1. Read read-tracking table

track <- read.delim(
  "read-count-tracking-wtrawreads.tsv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample")


# Keep EI1–EI48
track_96 <- track %>%
  filter(grepl("^EI[0-9]+", Sample)) %>%
  mutate(
    turtle_number = as.numeric(
      sub("^EI([0-9]+).*", "\\1", Sample)
    ),
    Sample_type = if_else(
      grepl("CL$", Sample, ignore.case = TRUE),
      "Cloaca",
      "Colon"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(turtle_number),
    turtle_number >= 1,
    turtle_number <= 48
  )


# Confirm 96 libraries
stopifnot(nrow(track_96) == 96)


# 2. Add final reads per sample from phy_mw
#nonchim = final reads after DADA2
# Final_reads = reads remaining in the cleaned phyloseq object

final_reads <- tibble(
  Sample = sample_names(phy_mw),
  Final_reads = as.numeric(sample_sums(phy_mw))
)

per_sample_summary <- track_96 %>%
  select(
    Sample,
    Sample_type,
    raw_reads,
    dada2_input,
    filtered,
    dada_f,
    dada_r,
    merged,
    nonchim
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Raw_reads = raw_reads,
    After_primer_adapter_removal = dada2_input,
    After_quality_filtering = filtered,
    Denoised_forward = dada_f,
    Denoised_reverse = dada_r,
    Merged_reads = merged,
    Non_chimeric_reads = nonchim
  ) %>%
  left_join(final_reads, by = "Sample")


# Check that all 96 samples matched
stopifnot(
  sum(is.na(per_sample_summary$Final_reads)) == 0
)


# 3. Rebuild original unfiltered phyloseq object
#
# ASVsS, taxfileS and mapfileS must still contain the original,
# unfiltered data used to create phy_mw.

phy_original <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(as.matrix(ASVsS), taxa_are_rows = TRUE),
  tax_table(as.matrix(taxfileS)),
  sample_data(as.data.frame(mapfileS))
)

# 4. Count taxonomic categories removed

tax_original <- as.data.frame(
  tax_table(phy_original),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Convert taxonomy columns to plain character
tax_original[] <- lapply(
  tax_original,
  function(x) trimws(as.character(x))
)

n_initial_asvs <- ntaxa(phy_original)

n_mitochondria <- sum(
  tax_original$Family == "Mitochondria",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_chloroplast <- sum(
  tax_original$Order == "Chloroplast",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_archaea <- sum(
  tax_original$Kingdom == "Archaea",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

n_eukaryotes <- sum(
  tax_original$Kingdom %in%
    c("Eukaryota", "Eukaryotes"),
  na.rm = TRUE
)


# 5. Reproduce your actual taxonomic and singleton filtering

phy_after_taxonomy <- phy_original %>%
  subset_taxa(
    Kingdom == "Bacteria" &
      Family != "Mitochondria" &
      Order != "Chloroplast"
  )

n_after_taxonomy <- ntaxa(phy_after_taxonomy)

phy_after_singletons <- phy_after_taxonomy %>%
  prune_taxa(taxa_sums(.) > 1, .)

n_after_singletons <- ntaxa(phy_after_singletons)

n_singletons_removed <-
  n_after_taxonomy - n_after_singletons



# 6. Restrict to EI1–EI48


sample_ids <- sample_names(phy_after_singletons)

ei_number <- suppressWarnings(
  as.numeric(
    sub("^EI([0-9]+).*", "\\1", sample_ids)
  )
)

keep_samples <- grepl("^EI[0-9]+", sample_ids) &
  !is.na(ei_number) &
  ei_number >= 1 &
  ei_number <= 48

phy_recreated_96 <- prune_samples(
  keep_samples,
  phy_after_singletons
)

phy_recreated_96 <- prune_samples(
  sample_sums(phy_recreated_96) > 0,
  phy_recreated_96
)

phy_recreated_96 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(phy_recreated_96) > 0,
  phy_recreated_96
)

# 7. Check recreated object against final phy_mw


cat("Recreated samples:", nsamples(phy_recreated_96), "\n")
cat("Current phy_mw samples:", nsamples(phy_mw), "\n")

cat("Recreated ASVs:", ntaxa(phy_recreated_96), "\n")
cat("Current phy_mw ASVs:", ntaxa(phy_mw), "\n")

if (
  nsamples(phy_recreated_96) != nsamples(phy_mw) ||
  ntaxa(phy_recreated_96) != ntaxa(phy_mw)
) {
  warning(
    "The recreated object does not exactly match phy_mw. ",
    "Check before using the filtering counts."
  )
}


# 8. ASV filtering summary
# Antony confirmed decontam removed zero ASVs.

n_asvs_removed_after_subset <-
  ntaxa(phy_after_singletons) - ntaxa(phy_recreated_96)

n_asvs_removed_after_subset



asv_filtering_summary <- tibble(
  Processing_step = c(
    "Initial ASVs before taxonomic filtering",

  ),

)
  


# 9. Rarefaction summary

rarefaction_depth <- 45815

n_before_rarefaction <- nsamples(phy_mw)

n_retained_rarefaction <- sum(
```

## Comment 8: Venn diagram 

```{r}
# ASV overlap sensitivity analysis
# Prevalence filters: 5% and 10%

otu_mat <- as(
  otu_table(phy_mw),
  "matrix"
)

# Ensure ASVs are rows
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_mw)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

meta_df <- as(
  sample_data(phy_mw),
  "data.frame"
)

colon_samples <- rownames(meta_df)[
  meta_df$sample_type == "colon"
]

cloaca_samples <- rownames(meta_df)[
  meta_df$sample_type == "cloaca"
]

stopifnot(
  length(colon_samples) == 48,
  length(cloaca_samples) == 48
)


# 2. Calculate prevalence within each sample type

prevalence_table <- tibble(
  ASV = rownames(otu_mat),

  n_colon = rowSums(
    otu_mat[, colon_samples, drop = FALSE] > 0
  ),

  n_cloaca = rowSums(
    otu_mat[, cloaca_samples, drop = FALSE] > 0
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    prevalence_colon =
      n_colon / length(colon_samples),

    prevalence_cloaca =
      n_cloaca / length(cloaca_samples)
  )



# 3. Function to calculate filtered overlap
# ASVs are retained when prevalence reaches the thresholdin at least one sample type.


calculate_overlap <- function(
    prevalence_df,
    threshold
) {

  filtered <- prevalence_df %>%
    filter(
      prevalence_colon >= threshold |
        prevalence_cloaca >= threshold
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      detected_colon = n_colon > 0,
      detected_cloaca = n_cloaca > 0,

      overlap_group = case_when(
        detected_colon & detected_cloaca ~
          "Shared",

        detected_colon & !detected_cloaca ~
          "Colon only",

        !detected_colon & detected_cloaca ~
          "Cloaca only",

        TRUE ~
          "Neither"
      )
    )

  summary <- filtered %>%
    count(
      overlap_group,
      name = "Number_of_ASVs"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Prevalence_threshold =
        paste0(threshold * 100, "%"),

      Percentage =
        100 * Number_of_ASVs /
        sum(Number_of_ASVs)
    )

  list(
    filtered_asvs = filtered,
    summary = summary
  )
}


# 4. Run 5% and 10% prevalence filters

overlap_5 <- calculate_overlap(
  prevalence_table,
  threshold = 0.05
)

overlap_10 <- calculate_overlap(
  prevalence_table,
  threshold = 0.10
)


# View summaries
print(overlap_5$summary)
print(overlap_10$summary)


# 5. Combine summaries

overlap_summary <- bind_rows(
  overlap_5$summary,
  overlap_10$summary
) %>%
  arrange(
    Prevalence_threshold,
    overlap_group
  )

print(overlap_summary)


# 6. Export results

write.csv(
  overlap_summary,
  "ASV_overlap_prevalence_filtered_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  overlap_5$filtered_asvs,
  "ASV_overlap_5percent_filtered_ASVs.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  overlap_10$filtered_asvs,
  "ASV_overlap_10percent_filtered_ASVs.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# 7. Update plot using 10% prevalance filter 


n_colon_only  <- 1410
n_shared      <- 1540
n_cloaca_only <- 7454

total_asvs <- n_colon_only + n_shared + n_cloaca_only


pct <- function(x) paste0(round(x / total_asvs * 100, 1), "%")

# Bubble radius approximately proportional to total ASVs
r_colon  <- 0.75
r_cloaca <- 1.55
```

##Venn Diagram interpret at family and phylum level
```{r}


# 1. Add taxonomy to the ASVs retained in the 10% Venn analysis
taxonomy_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_mw)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV")

venn_taxonomy <- overlap_10$filtered_asvs %>%
  left_join(taxonomy_df, by = "ASV") %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    overlap_group,
    n_colon,
    prevalence_colon,
    n_cloaca,
    prevalence_cloaca,
    everything()
  )


# 2. Phylum summary
# Percentages are calculated relative to ALL ASVs within each Venn category
# Unclassified ASVs are retained so that denominators equal the Venn totals.

phylum_summary <- venn_taxonomy %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = ifelse(
      is.na(Phylum) | Phylum == "",
      "Unclassified",
      Phylum
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    overlap_group,
    Phylum,
    name = "n_ASVs"
  ) %>%
  group_by(overlap_group) %>%
  mutate(
    total_ASVs_in_group = sum(n_ASVs),
    percent_ASVs = round(
      100 * n_ASVs / total_ASVs_in_group,
      2
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(
    overlap_group,
    desc(n_ASVs)
  )


# 3. Family summary
# Percentages are calculated relative to ALL ASVs within each Venn category
# Unclassified ASVs are retained so that denominators equal the Venn totals.

family_summary <- venn_taxonomy %>%
  mutate(
    Family = ifelse(
      is.na(Family) | Family == "",
      "Unclassified",
      Family
    )
  ) %>%
  count(
    overlap_group,
    Family,
    name = "n_ASVs"
  ) %>%
  group_by(overlap_group) %>%
  mutate(
    total_ASVs_in_group = sum(n_ASVs),
    percent_ASVs = round(
      100 * n_ASVs / total_ASVs_in_group,
      2
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(
    overlap_group,
    desc(n_ASVs)
  )


# 4. Optional checks: top taxa in each Venn category

top_phyla <- phylum_summary %>%
  group_by(overlap_group) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = n_ASVs,
    n = 10,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

top_families <- family_summary %>%
  group_by(overlap_group) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = n_ASVs,
    n = 15,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

print(top_phyla)
print(top_families)


# 5. Check that denominators match the 10% Venn totals

venn_check <- venn_taxonomy %>%
  count(
    overlap_group,
    name = "total_ASVs"
  )

print(venn_check)


# 6. Create one Excel workbook

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "ASV taxonomy")
addWorksheet(wb, "Phylum summary")

writeData(
```

##Comment: LefSe
```{r}
## Reviewer comment: LEfSe biomarker analysis
## LEfSe is used as a supplementary biomarker analysis.
## ANCOM-BC2 remains the primary differential-abundance analysis because it accounts for the paired design using turtle_ID as a random effect.


phy_lefse <- phy_asv

stopifnot(
  nsamples(phy_lefse) == 96,
  sum(sample_data(phy_lefse)$sample_type == "colon") == 48,
  sum(sample_data(phy_lefse)$sample_type == "cloaca") == 48
)

# 2. Apply same 10% prevalence filter used for ANCOM-BC2
otu_lefse <- as(otu_table(phy_lefse), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_lefse)) {
  otu_lefse <- t(otu_lefse)
}

keep_asvs <- rownames(otu_lefse)[
  rowMeans(otu_lefse > 0) >= 0.10
]

phy_lefse <- prune_taxa(keep_asvs, phy_lefse)
phy_lefse <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_lefse) > 0, phy_lefse)

sample_data(phy_lefse)$sample_type <- factor(
  as.character(sample_data(phy_lefse)$sample_type),
  levels = c("cloaca", "colon")
)
cat("Samples used:", nsamples(phy_lefse), "\n")
cat("ASVs tested:", ntaxa(phy_lefse), "\n")
print(table(sample_data(phy_lefse)$sample_type))

# 3. Run LEfSe LDA >= 3, consistent with Scheelings et al. (2020)

set.seed(123)
lefse_asv <- run_lefse(
  ps = phy_lefse,
  group = "sample_type",
  taxa_rank = "none",
  transform = "identity",
  norm = "CPM",
  kw_cutoff = 0.05,
  lda_cutoff = 3,
  bootstrap_n = 30,
  bootstrap_fraction = 2/3,
  multigrp_strat = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  lefse_asv,
  "LEfSe_colon_vs_cloaca_ASV_LDA3.rds"
)
# 4. Extract results
lefse_raw <- marker_table(lefse_asv)
class(lefse_raw) <- "data.frame"

lefse_results <- data.frame(
  ASV = as.character(lefse_raw$feature),
  LEfSe_group = as.character(lefse_raw$enrich_group),
  LEfSe_LDA = as.numeric(lefse_raw$ef_lda),
  LEfSe_p = as.numeric(lefse_raw$pvalue),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    LEfSe_direction = case_when(
      LEfSe_group == "colon"  ~ "Colon-enriched",
      LEfSe_group == "cloaca" ~ "Cloaca-enriched",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Add taxonomy
tax_lefse <- as.data.frame(
  tax_table(phy_lefse),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV")

lefse_results <- lefse_results %>%
  left_join(tax_lefse, by = "ASV") %>%
  arrange(desc(LEfSe_LDA))

cat("\nTotal LEfSe markers:", nrow(lefse_results), "\n")
print(table(lefse_results$LEfSe_direction))

cat("\nTop LEfSe markers:\n")
print(
  lefse_results %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      Genus,
      Family,
      LEfSe_direction,
      LEfSe_LDA,
      LEfSe_p
    ) %>%
    head(20)
)


# 5. Compare LEfSe with robust paired ANCOM-BC2 results
sig_asv_robust_saved <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(
  "ANCOMBC2_paired_colon_vs_cloaca_complete.xlsx",
  sheet = "Robust_significant_ASVs"
)

cat(
  "\nRobust significant ANCOM-BC2 ASVs:",
  nrow(sig_asv_robust_saved),
  "\n"
)

print(
  table(
    sig_asv_robust_saved$direction,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

ancom_compare <- sig_asv_robust_saved %>%
  select(
    ASV,
    ANCOM_logFC = logFC,
    ANCOM_q = q_val,
    ANCOM_direction = direction
  )

# 6. Join LEfSe and robust ANCOM-BC2 results
lefse_ancom_comparison <- full_join(
  
  lefse_results %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      LEfSe_group,
      LEfSe_direction,
      LEfSe_LDA,
      LEfSe_p,
      any_of(c(
        "Kingdom",
        "Phylum",
        "Class",
        "Order",
        "Family",
        "Genus"
      ))
    ),
  
  ancom_compare,
  
  by = "ASV"
  
) %>%
  mutate(
    
    significant_LEfSe =
      !is.na(LEfSe_LDA),
    
    significant_ANCOM =
      !is.na(ANCOM_logFC),
    
    method_agreement = case_when(
      
      significant_LEfSe &
        significant_ANCOM &
        LEfSe_direction == ANCOM_direction ~
        "Both - same direction",
      
      significant_LEfSe &
        significant_ANCOM &
        LEfSe_direction != ANCOM_direction ~
        "Both - opposite direction",
      
      significant_LEfSe &
        !significant_ANCOM ~
        "LEfSe only",
      
      !significant_LEfSe &
        significant_ANCOM ~
        "ANCOM-BC2 only",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# summarize

cat("\nLEfSe vs robust ANCOM-BC2:\n")

print(
  lefse_ancom_comparison %>%
    count(method_agreement)
)


shared_markers <- lefse_ancom_comparison %>%
  filter(
    method_agreement == "Both - same direction"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(LEfSe_LDA)
  )


discordant_markers <- lefse_ancom_comparison %>%
  filter(
    method_agreement == "Both - opposite direction"
  )


cat(
  "\nLEfSe total:",
  sum(
    lefse_ancom_comparison$significant_LEfSe,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  
  "\nRobust ANCOM-BC2 total:",
  sum(
    lefse_ancom_comparison$significant_ANCOM,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  
  "\nOverlap:",
  sum(
    lefse_ancom_comparison$significant_LEfSe &
      lefse_ancom_comparison$significant_ANCOM,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  
  "\nSame direction:",
  nrow(shared_markers),
  
  "\nOpposite direction:",
  nrow(discordant_markers),
  
  "\n"
)


cat("\nShared markers:\n")

print(
  shared_markers %>%
    select(
      ASV,
      Genus,
      Family,
      LEfSe_direction,
      LEfSe_LDA,
      LEfSe_p,
      ANCOM_logFC,
      ANCOM_q
    ) %>%
    head(30)
)

#exportr

write_xlsx(
  list(
    
    LEfSe_LDA3 =
      lefse_results,
    
    Robust_ANCOMBC2 =
      sig_asv_robust_saved,
    
    LEfSe_ANCOM_comparison =
      lefse_ancom_comparison,
    
    Shared_same_direction =
      shared_markers,
    
    LEfSe_only =
      lefse_ancom_comparison %>%
      filter(
        method_agreement == "LEfSe only"
      ),
    
    ANCOM_only =
      lefse_ancom_comparison %>%
      filter(
        method_agreement == "ANCOM-BC2 only"
      ),
    
    Opposite_direction =
      discordant_markers
  ),
  
  "LEfSe_LDA3_vs_ANCOMBC2_robust_colon_cloaca.xlsx"
)
```

```{r}
# 1. Prepare PICRUSt2 input files

asv_fasta <- readDNAStringSet("ASVs-no-contam.fa")

shared_ids <- intersect(taxa_names(phy_asv), names(asv_fasta))

c(
  final_phyloseq_ASVs = ntaxa(phy_asv),
  FASTA_ASVs = length(asv_fasta),
  matching_ASVs = length(shared_ids),
  missing_from_FASTA = length(setdiff(taxa_names(phy_asv), names(asv_fasta))),
  extra_in_FASTA = length(setdiff(names(asv_fasta), taxa_names(phy_asv)))
)

# Retain only ASVs in final phyloseq object, in identical order
asv_fasta_final <- asv_fasta[taxa_names(phy_asv)]

stopifnot(
  identical(names(asv_fasta_final), taxa_names(phy_asv))
)

dir.create("picrust2_input", showWarnings = FALSE)

writeXStringSet(
  asv_fasta_final,
  "picrust2_input/ASV_sequences.fasta",
  format = "fasta"
)

# Raw ASV count table
otu_picrust <- as(otu_table(phy_asv), "matrix")

if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_asv)) {
  otu_picrust <- t(otu_picrust)
}

otu_picrust <- as.data.frame(
  otu_picrust,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV")

write.table(
  otu_picrust,
  "picrust2_input/ASV_abundance.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  setequal(names(asv_fasta_final), otu_picrust$ASV)
)

c(
  FASTA_ASVs = length(asv_fasta_final),
  count_table_ASVs = nrow(otu_picrust)
)

getwd()


# TERMINAL STEP to run PICRUST2


# 2. Inspect output and prediction quality 

list.files("picrust2_output")

nsti <- read_tsv(
  "picrust2_output/combined_marker_predicted_and_nsti.tsv.gz",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

nsti_col <- grep(
  "NSTI",
  names(nsti),

)

if (length(nsti_col) == 1) {
  nsti_values <- nsti[[nsti_col]]

  print(summary(nsti_values))

  c(
    median_NSTI = median(nsti_values, na.rm = TRUE),

    proportion_NSTI_over_0.5 = mean(nsti_values > 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    proportion_NSTI_over_1 = mean(nsti_values > 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

weighted_nsti <- read_tsv(
  "picrust2_output/KO_metagenome_out/weighted_nsti.tsv.gz",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

print(summary(weighted_nsti))

list.files("picrust2_output/pathways_out", recursive = TRUE)
list.files("picrust2_output/KO_metagenome_out", recursive = TRUE)
list.files("picrust2_output/EC_metagenome_out", recursive = TRUE)


# 3. Read predicted MetaCyc pathways and match samples

pathways <- read_tsv(
  "picrust2_output/pathways_out/path_abun_unstrat.tsv.gz",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

path_mat <- pathways %>%
  column_to_rownames("pathway") %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(path_mat) <- "numeric"

stopifnot(
  setequal(colnames(path_mat), sample_names(phy_asv))
)

# Put pathway samples in same order as phyloseq
path_mat <- path_mat[, sample_names(phy_asv), drop = FALSE]

meta_picrust <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_asv))[
  sample_names(phy_asv),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(path_mat), rownames(meta_picrust))
)

table(meta_picrust$sample_type)
table(table(meta_picrust$turtle_ID))

# Remove pathways absent from every sample
path_mat <- path_mat[
  rowSums(path_mat) > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

path_prev <- rowMeans(path_mat > 0)

c(
  pathways_total = nrow(path_mat),
  prevalence_10pct = sum(path_prev >= 0.10),
  prevalence_25pct = sum(path_prev >= 0.25),
  prevalence_50pct = sum(path_prev >= 0.50),
  prevalence_90pct = sum(path_prev >= 0.90)
)


# 4. Overall predicted pathway composition

# CLR transformation with pseudocount
clr_path <- apply(
  path_mat + 1,
  2,
  function(x) log(x) - mean(log(x))
)

clr_path_samples <- t(clr_path)

stopifnot(
  identical(rownames(clr_path_samples), rownames(meta_picrust))
)

dist_path <- dist(clr_path_samples, method = "euclidean")

# PCoA
pcoa_path <- cmdscale(
  dist_path,
  eig = TRUE,
  k = 2
)

pcoa_df <- data.frame(
  sample_name = rownames(pcoa_path$points),
  Axis1 = pcoa_path$points[, 1],
  Axis2 = pcoa_path$points[, 2]
)

pcoa_df <- cbind(
  pcoa_df,
  meta_picrust[pcoa_df$sample_name, , drop = FALSE]
)

eig_positive <- pcoa_path$eig[pcoa_path$eig > 0]

axis1_var <- 100 * eig_positive[1] / sum(eig_positive)
axis2_var <- 100 * eig_positive[2] / sum(eig_positive)

p_picrust_pcoa <- ggplot(
  pcoa_df,
  aes(
    Axis1,
    Axis2,
    shape = sample_type
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(group = sample_type),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", round(axis1_var, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", round(axis2_var, 1), "%)"),
    title = "PICRUSt2 predicted MetaCyc pathway profiles",
    shape = "Sample type"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

p_picrust_pcoa


# 5. Paired PERMANOVA

set.seed(123)

perm_path <- how(
  nperm = 9999,
  blocks = meta_picrust$turtle_ID
)

permanova_path <- adonis2(
  dist_path ~ sample_type,
  data = meta_picrust,
  permutations = perm_path
)

print(permanova_path)


# 6. PERMDISP

disp_path <- betadisper(
  dist_path,
  group = meta_picrust$sample_type
)

set.seed(123)

disp_perm <- permutest(

)

print(disp_perm)

disp_df <- data.frame(

disp_summary <- disp_df %>%

print(disp_summary)

# 7. Differential predicted MetaCyc pathways
# Paired Wilcoxon on predicted abundances

path_mat_filt <- path_mat[
  rowMeans(path_mat > 0) >= 0.10,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample_name = rownames(meta_picrust),
  turtle_ID = meta_picrust$turtle_ID,
  sample_type = as.character(meta_picrust$sample_type)
)

path_pairs <- as.data.frame(path_mat_filt) %>%
  rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -pathway,
    names_to = "sample_name",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_info,
    by = "sample_name"
  ) %>%
  select(
    pathway,
    turtle_ID,
    sample_type,
    abundance
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = abundance
  )

pathway_results <- path_pairs %>%
  group_by(pathway) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pairs = sum(complete.cases(colon, cloaca)),
    mean_colon = mean(colon, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cloaca = mean(cloaca, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_colon = median(colon, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_cloaca = median(cloaca, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence_colon = mean(colon > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    prevalence_cloaca = mean(cloaca > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_paired_difference = median(
      colon - cloaca,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    log2_mean_ratio = log2(
      (mean(colon, na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
        (mean(cloaca, na.rm = TRUE) + 1)
    ),
    p_value = wilcox.test(
      colon,
      cloaca,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    associated_group = case_when(
      q_value < 0.05 &
        median_paired_difference > 0 ~ "Colon",
      q_value < 0.05 &
        median_paired_difference < 0 ~ "Cloaca",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_value, p_value)

c(
  pathways_tested = nrow(pathway_results),
  significant_BH = sum(pathway_results$q_value < 0.05),
  colon_associated = sum(pathway_results$associated_group == "Colon"),
  cloaca_associated = sum(pathway_results$associated_group == "Cloaca")
)

print(
  pathway_results %>%
    select(
      pathway,
      n_pairs,
      prevalence_colon,
      prevalence_cloaca,
      median_paired_difference,
      log2_mean_ratio,
      p_value,
      q_value,
      associated_group
    ) %>%
    slice_head(n = 30),
  n = 30
)

dir.create("picrust2_results", showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  pathway_results,
  "picrust2_results/PICRUSt2_MetaCyc_paired_pathway_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

p_path_effects <- ggplot(

  )
) +
  geom_point(

    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log2 mean abundance ratio (colon / cloaca)",
    y = "-log10(BH-adjusted p-value)",
    shape = NULL,
    title = "PICRUSt2 predicted MetaCyc pathways"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

p_path_effects

ggsave(

  "picrust2_figures/PICRUSt2_MetaCyc_pathway_effects.png",
  p_path_effects,
  width = 7,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 600
)


# 8. Predicted pathway richness and Shannon diversity

meta_path <- meta_picrust[
  colnames(path_mat),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(colnames(path_mat), rownames(meta_path))
)

pathway_richness <- colSums(
  path_mat > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

path_rel_div <- sweep(
  path_mat,
  2,
  colSums(path_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
  "/"
)

pathway_shannon <- apply(
  path_rel_div,
  2,
  function(x) {
    x <- x[x > 0 & !is.na(x)]
    -sum(x * log(x))
  }
)

pathway_alpha <- data.frame(
  sample_name = colnames(path_mat),
  turtle_ID = meta_path$turtle_ID,
  sample_type = as.character(meta_path$sample_type),
  pathway_richness = pathway_richness,
  pathway_shannon = pathway_shannon
)

pathway_alpha_summary <- pathway_alpha %>%
  group_by(sample_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_richness = mean(pathway_richness),
    median_richness = median(pathway_richness),
    sd_richness = sd(pathway_richness),
    mean_shannon = mean(pathway_shannon),
    median_shannon = median(pathway_shannon),
    sd_shannon = sd(pathway_shannon),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(pathway_alpha_summary)

pathway_alpha_wide <- pathway_alpha %>%
  select(
    turtle_ID,
    sample_type,
    pathway_richness,
    pathway_shannon
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_type,
    values_from = c(
      pathway_richness,
      pathway_shannon
    )
  )

richness_test <- wilcox.test(
  pathway_alpha_wide$pathway_richness_colon,
  pathway_alpha_wide$pathway_richness_cloaca,
  paired = TRUE,
  exact = FALSE
)

shannon_test <- wilcox.test(
  pathway_alpha_wide$pathway_shannon_colon,
  pathway_alpha_wide$pathway_shannon_cloaca,
  paired = TRUE,
  exact = FALSE
)

print(richness_test)
print(shannon_test)

summary(
  pathway_alpha_wide$pathway_richness_colon -
    pathway_alpha_wide$pathway_richness_cloaca
)

summary(
  pathway_alpha_wide$pathway_shannon_colon -
    pathway_alpha_wide$pathway_shannon_cloaca
)

p_pathway_richness <- ggplot(

    sample_type,
    pathway_richness,
    group = turtle_ID
  )

  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Predicted MetaCyc pathway richness",
    title = "Predicted pathway richness"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

p_pathway_shannon <- ggplot(
  pathway_alpha,
  aes(
    sample_type,
    pathway_shannon,
    group = turtle_ID
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Predicted MetaCyc pathway Shannon diversity",
    title = "Predicted pathway diversity"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p_pathway_richness)
print(p_pathway_shannon)

write.csv(
  pathway_alpha,
  "picrust2_results/MetaCyc_predicted_pathway_diversity_per_sample.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  pathway_alpha_summary,
  "picrust2_results/MetaCyc_predicted_pathway_diversity_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

dir.create(
  "picrust2_figures/MetaCyc",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  "picrust2_figures/MetaCyc/MetaCyc_predicted_pathway_richness.pdf",
  p_pathway_richness,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  "picrust2_figures/MetaCyc/MetaCyc_predicted_pathway_shannon.pdf",
  p_pathway_shannon,
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)


# 9. Total predicted pathway abundance per sample

total_pathway_abundance <- colSums(
  path_mat,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

total_df <- data.frame(
  sample_name = names(total_pathway_abundance),
  total_pathway_abundance = total_pathway_abundance,
  sample_type = meta_path$sample_type,
  turtle_ID = meta_path$turtle_ID
)

print(
  total_df %>%
    group_by(sample_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean(total_pathway_abundance),
      median = median(total_pathway_abundance),
      sd = sd(total_pathway_abundance),
      min = min(total_pathway_abundance),

      .groups = "drop"
    )

total_wide <- total_df %>%

    turtle_ID,

    total_pathway_abundance
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(

  )

total_test <- wilcox.test(
  total_wide$colon,
  total_wide$cloaca,
  paired = TRUE,

print(total_test)

summary(
  total_wide$colon -

p_total <- ggplot(

    sample_type,

  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +

    x = NULL,

p_total


# 10. Relative-abundance pathway analysis

path_rel <- sweep(
  path_mat,
  2,
  colSums(path_mat),
  "/"
)

print(summary(colSums(path_rel)))

path_rel <- path_rel[
  rowSums(path_rel) > 0,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

results_rel <- vector(
  "list",
  nrow(path_rel)
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(path_rel))) {

  values <- path_rel[i, ]

  wide <- data.frame(
    turtle_ID = meta_path$turtle_ID,
    sample_type = meta_path$sample_type,
    abundance = values
  ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = sample_type,
      values_from = abundance
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(colon),
      !is.na(cloaca)
    )

  n_pairs <- nrow(wide)

  if (n_pairs < 3) next

  paired_difference <- wide$colon - wide$cloaca

  p_value <- if (all(paired_difference == 0)) {
    1
  } else {
    suppressWarnings(
      wilcox.test(
        wide$colon,
        wide$cloaca,
        paired = TRUE,
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value
    )
  }

  mean_colon <- mean(wide$colon, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_cloaca <- mean(wide$cloaca, na.rm = TRUE)

  positive_values <- c(
    wide$colon[wide$colon > 0],
    wide$cloaca[wide$cloaca > 0]
  )

  log2_mean_ratio <- if (length(positive_values) > 0) {
    pseudocount <- min(positive_values) / 2

    log2(
      (mean_colon + pseudocount) /
        (mean_cloaca + pseudocount)
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  results_rel[[i]] <- data.frame(
    pathway = rownames(path_rel)[i],
    n_pairs = n_pairs,
    prevalence_colon = mean(wide$colon > 0),
    prevalence_cloaca = mean(wide$cloaca > 0),
    mean_relative_abundance_colon = mean_colon,
    mean_relative_abundance_cloaca = mean_cloaca,
    median_relative_abundance_colon = median(wide$colon),
    median_relative_abundance_cloaca = median(wide$cloaca),
    median_paired_difference = median(paired_difference),
    log2_mean_ratio = log2_mean_ratio,
    p_value = p_value
  )
}

pathway_results_rel <- bind_rows(results_rel) %>%
  mutate(
    q_value = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    associated_group = case_when(
      q_value < 0.05 &
        mean_relative_abundance_colon >
          mean_relative_abundance_cloaca ~ "Colon",
      q_value < 0.05 &
        mean_relative_abundance_cloaca >
          mean_relative_abundance_colon ~ "Cloaca",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_value, p_value)

c(
  pathways_tested = nrow(pathway_results_rel),
  significant_BH = sum(pathway_results_rel$q_value < 0.05),
  colon_associated = sum(pathway_results_rel$associated_group == "Colon"),
  cloaca_associated = sum(pathway_results_rel$associated_group == "Cloaca")
)

top30_rel <- pathway_results_rel %>%
  select(
    pathway,
    n_pairs,
    prevalence_colon,
    prevalence_cloaca,
    mean_relative_abundance_colon,
    mean_relative_abundance_cloaca,
    median_paired_difference,
    log2_mean_ratio,
    p_value,
    q_value,
    associated_group
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 30)

print(top30_rel, n = 30)

write.csv(
  pathway_results_rel,
  "picrust2_results/PICRUSt2_MetaCyc_paired_relative_abundance_results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  "picrust2_results/PICRUSt2_total_pathway_abundance_colon_cloaca.pdf",
  p_total,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  "picrust2_results/PICRUSt2_total_pathway_abundance_colon_cloaca.png",
  p_total,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# 1. Find and import MetaCyc pathway annotation map

  "/opt/miniconda3/envs/picrust2",
  pattern = "metacyc.*pathway.*info.*\\.txt.*$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(possible_maps) == 0) {
  stop("No MetaCyc pathway description map found.")
}

prok_map <- possible_maps[
  grepl("prokary", possible_maps, ignore.case = TRUE)
]

map_file <- if (length(prok_map) > 0) {
  prok_map[1]
} else {
  possible_maps[1]
}

print(map_file)

metacyc_annotation <- read_tsv(
  map_file,
  comment = "#",
  col_names = c("pathway", "pathway_name"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    pathway = as.character(pathway),
    pathway_name = as.character(pathway_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct(pathway, .keep_all = TRUE)


# 2. Merge pathway annotations

pathway_annotated <- pathway_results_rel %>%

    metacyc_annotation,

    pathway_text_lower = str_to_lower(pathway_text)
```
