###Filtering Meta Cyc
```{r}
############################################################
# MetaCyc effect-size analysis — CORRECT metadata setup
############################################################

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Make sure meta_picrust has a sample column
# ----------------------------------------------------------

if (!"sample" %in% names(meta_picrust)) {

  meta_picrust$sample <- rownames(meta_picrust)

}

cat("\nMetadata columns:\n")
print(names(meta_picrust))

cat("\nFirst sample IDs:\n")
print(head(meta_picrust$sample))


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build per-sample MetaCyc relative-abundance table
# ----------------------------------------------------------

metacyc_long <- pathways %>%

  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -pathway,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "predicted_abundance"
  ) %>%

  dplyr::group_by(
    sample
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(
    relative_abundance =
      predicted_abundance /
      sum(
        predicted_abundance,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::ungroup()


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 3. FIRST check sample matching BEFORE joining
# ----------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("METADATA MATCH CHECK\n")
cat("============================================\n")

cat("\nSamples in MetaCyc table:\n")
print(length(unique(metacyc_long$sample)))

cat("\nSamples in metadata:\n")
print(length(unique(meta_picrust$sample)))

cat("\nDo sample IDs match exactly?\n")
print(
  setequal(
    unique(metacyc_long$sample),
    meta_picrust$sample
  )
)

cat("\nMetaCyc samples missing from metadata:\n")
print(
  setdiff(
    unique(metacyc_long$sample),
    meta_picrust$sample
  )
)

cat("\nMetadata samples missing from MetaCyc:\n")
print(
  setdiff(
    meta_picrust$sample,
    unique(metacyc_long$sample)
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Join metadata
# ----------------------------------------------------------

metacyc_long <- metacyc_long %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_picrust,
    by = "sample"
  )

cat("\nMissing turtle IDs:\n")
print(sum(is.na(metacyc_long$turtle_ID)))

cat("\nMissing sample types:\n")
print(sum(is.na(metacyc_long$sample_type)))

cat("\nSample types represented:\n")
print(
  table(
    metacyc_long$sample_type,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Critical sanity checks
# ----------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("METACYC LONG TABLE CHECK\n")
cat("============================================\n")

cat("\nDimensions:\n")
print(dim(metacyc_long))

cat("\nMissing turtle IDs:\n")
print(
  sum(
    is.na(metacyc_long$turtle_ID)
  )
)

cat("\nMissing sample types:\n")
print(
  sum(
    is.na(metacyc_long$sample_type)
  )
)

cat("\nSample types represented:\n")
print(
  table(
    metacyc_long$sample_type,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)

stopifnot(
  !any(is.na(metacyc_long$turtle_ID)),
  !any(is.na(metacyc_long$sample_type))
)

cat("\nMetaCyc relative-abundance table ready.\n")




# ==========================================================
# 2. FUNCTION TO CALCULATE PAIRED RANK-BISERIAL EFFECT SIZE
# ==========================================================

metacyc_effect_size <- function(pathway_id) {

  tmp <- metacyc_long %>%

    filter(
      pathway == pathway_id
    ) %>%

    select(
      turtle_ID,
      sample_type,
      relative_abundance
    ) %>%

    group_by(
      turtle_ID,
      sample_type
    ) %>%

    summarise(
      relative_abundance =
        sum(
          relative_abundance,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%

    pivot_wider(
      names_from = sample_type,
      values_from = relative_abundance
    ) %>%

    filter(
      !is.na(colon),
      !is.na(cloaca)
    )


  if (nrow(tmp) < 2) {

    return(
      tibble(
        pathway = pathway_id,
        rank_biserial = NA_real_,
        rb_CI_low = NA_real_,
        rb_CI_high = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }


  rb <- effectsize::rank_biserial(
    tmp$colon,
    tmp$cloaca,
    paired = TRUE,
    ci = 0.95
  )


  rb_df <- as.data.frame(rb)


  effect_col <- names(rb_df)[
    grepl(
      "rank_biserial|r_rank_biserial|rb",
      names(rb_df),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ][1]


  low_col <- names(rb_df)[
    grepl(
      "CI_low|CI.low",
      names(rb_df),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ][1]


  high_col <- names(rb_df)[
    grepl(
      "CI_high|CI.high",
      names(rb_df),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ][1]


  tibble(

    pathway = pathway_id,

    rank_biserial =
      as.numeric(
        rb_df[[effect_col]][1]
      ),

    rb_CI_low =
      if (!is.na(low_col))
        as.numeric(
          rb_df[[low_col]][1]
        )
      else
        NA_real_,

    rb_CI_high =
      if (!is.na(high_col))
        as.numeric(
          rb_df[[high_col]][1]
        )
      else
        NA_real_
  )
}


# ==========================================================
# 3. CALCULATE EFFECT SIZE FOR ALL MetaCyc PATHWAYS
# ==========================================================

metacyc_effects <- lapply(
  unique(
    pathway_annotated$pathway
  ),
  metacyc_effect_size
) %>%
  bind_rows()


cat(
  "\nMetaCyc pathways with effect sizes:",
  nrow(metacyc_effects),
  "\n"
)


# ==========================================================
# 4. JOIN EFFECT SIZES TO ANNOTATED RESULTS
# ==========================================================

metacyc_all_effects <- pathway_annotated %>%

  left_join(
    metacyc_effects,
    by = "pathway"
  ) %>%

  mutate(

    abs_rank_biserial =
      abs(
        rank_biserial
      ),

    # Use paired difference already calculated in your
    # relative-abundance analysis
    abs_median_difference =
      abs(
        median_paired_difference
      ),

    direction =
      case_when(

        median_paired_difference > 0 ~
          "Colon",

        median_paired_difference < 0 ~
          "Cloaca",

        TRUE ~
          "No difference"
      ),

    significant_FDR =
      q_value < 0.05,

    q_for_score =
      pmax(
        q_value,
        .Machine$double.xmin
      ),

    neg_log10_q =
      -log10(
        q_for_score
      )

  )


# ==========================================================
# 5. CHECK DIRECTION AGREEMENT
#
# rank-biserial sign and median paired difference should
# point in the same direction.
# ==========================================================

direction_check <- metacyc_all_effects %>%

  filter(
    !is.na(rank_biserial),
    !is.na(median_paired_difference)
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    same_direction =
      sign(rank_biserial) ==
      sign(median_paired_difference)
  )


cat(
  "\nDirection agreement between rank-biserial and",
  " median paired difference:\n"
)

print(
  table(
    direction_check$same_direction,
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)


# ==========================================================
# 6. FDR-SIGNIFICANT PATHWAYS ELIGIBLE FOR PRIORITIZATION
# ==========================================================

metacyc_sig_ranked <- metacyc_all_effects %>%

  filter(
    significant_FDR,
    !is.na(rank_biserial),
    !is.na(median_paired_difference)
  )


cat(
  "\n============================================\n",
  "MetaCyc SIGNIFICANT PATHWAYS\n",
  "============================================\n"
)

cat(
  "\nTotal pathways:",
  nrow(metacyc_all_effects),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "BH q < 0.05:",
  nrow(metacyc_sig_ranked),
  "\n"
)


# ==========================================================
# 7. CALCULATE PERCENTILE SCORES
#
# Three independent ranking dimensions:
#
#   FDR evidence
#   paired effect magnitude
#   abundance difference magnitude
# ==========================================================

metacyc_sig_ranked <- metacyc_sig_ranked %>%

  mutate(

    score_FDR =
      percent_rank(
        neg_log10_q
      ),

    score_effect =
      percent_rank(
        abs_rank_biserial
      ),

    score_magnitude =
      percent_rank(
        abs_median_difference
      )

  ) %>%

  rowwise() %>%

  mutate(

    priority_score =
      mean(
        c(
          score_FDR,
          score_effect,
          score_magnitude
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

  ) %>%

  ungroup() %>%

  arrange(
    desc(priority_score)
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    global_priority_rank =
      row_number()
  )


# ==========================================================
# 8. TOP 50 MetaCyc PATHWAYS GLOBALLY
# ==========================================================

metacyc_top50 <- metacyc_sig_ranked %>%

  slice_head(
    n = 50
  )


cat(
  "\n============================================\n",
  "TOP 50 MetaCyc PATHWAYS\n",
  "============================================\n"
)


print(
  as.data.frame(
    metacyc_top50 %>%

      select(
        global_priority_rank,
        pathway,
        pathway_name,
        functional_theme,
        mean_relative_abundance_colon,
        mean_relative_abundance_cloaca,
        median_paired_difference,
        rank_biserial,
        q_value,
        priority_score,
        direction
      )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 9. RANK WITHIN EACH FUNCTIONAL THEME
#
# NOTE:
# functional_theme is your keyword-based exploratory grouping,
# not a formal MetaCyc ontology.
# ==========================================================

metacyc_within_theme <- metacyc_sig_ranked %>%

  group_by(
    functional_theme
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(priority_score),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    rank_within_theme =
      row_number()
  ) %>%

  ungroup()


# ==========================================================
# 10. TOP 5 PATHWAYS PER FUNCTIONAL THEME
# ==========================================================

metacyc_top5_per_theme <- metacyc_within_theme %>%

  filter(
    rank_within_theme <= 5
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    functional_theme,
    rank_within_theme
  )


cat(
  "\n============================================\n",
  "TOP 5 MetaCyc PATHWAYS PER THEME\n",
  "============================================\n"
)


print(
  as.data.frame(
    metacyc_top5_per_theme %>%

      select(
        functional_theme,
        rank_within_theme,
        pathway,
        pathway_name,
        median_paired_difference,
        rank_biserial,
        q_value,
        priority_score,
        direction
      )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 11. FERMENTATION / SCFA PATHWAYS
#
# Keep ALL pathways matching your original keyword-defined
# fermentation category.
#
# Do not require them to rank highly.
# ==========================================================

metacyc_fermentation_final <- metacyc_all_effects %>%

  filter(
    functional_theme ==
      "Fermentation / SCFA-related"
  ) %>%

  left_join(

    metacyc_sig_ranked %>%

      select(
        pathway,
        priority_score,
        global_priority_rank
      ),

    by = "pathway"
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(abs_rank_biserial)
  )


cat(
  "\n============================================\n",
  "FERMENTATION / SCFA MetaCyc PATHWAYS\n",
  "============================================\n"
)


print(
  as.data.frame(
    metacyc_fermentation_final %>%

      select(
        pathway,
        pathway_name,
        mean_relative_abundance_colon,
        mean_relative_abundance_cloaca,
        median_paired_difference,
        rank_biserial,
        q_value,
        priority_score,
        global_priority_rank,
        direction
      )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 12. CARBOHYDRATE PATHWAYS
# ==========================================================

metacyc_carbohydrate_final <- metacyc_all_effects %>%

  filter(
    functional_theme ==
      "Carbohydrate metabolism"
  ) %>%

  left_join(

    metacyc_sig_ranked %>%

      select(
        pathway,
        priority_score,
        global_priority_rank
      ),

    by = "pathway"
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(abs_rank_biserial)
  )


cat(
  "\n============================================\n",
  "CARBOHYDRATE MetaCyc PATHWAYS\n",
  "============================================\n"
)


print(
  as.data.frame(
    metacyc_carbohydrate_final %>%

      select(
        pathway,
        pathway_name,
        mean_relative_abundance_colon,
        mean_relative_abundance_cloaca,
        median_paired_difference,
        rank_biserial,
        q_value,
        priority_score,
        global_priority_rank,
        direction
      )
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ==========================================================
# 13. SUMMARY OF FUNCTIONAL THEMES
#
# This is still exploratory because the themes are based
# on keywords rather than formal MetaCyc categories.
# ==========================================================

# ==========================================================
# CREATE MetaCyc THEME EFFECT SUMMARY
# ==========================================================

metacyc_theme_effect_summary <- metacyc_sig_ranked %>%

  group_by(
    functional_theme
  ) %>%

  summarise(

    n_significant =
      n(),

    colon_n =
      sum(
        direction == "Colon",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    cloaca_n =
      sum(
        direction == "Cloaca",
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    median_abs_effect =
      median(
        abs_rank_biserial,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    median_abs_abundance_difference =
      median(
        abs_median_difference,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"

  ) %>%

  mutate(

    colon_percent =
      100 *
      colon_n /
      n_significant,

    cloaca_percent =
      100 *
      cloaca_n /
      n_significant

  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(n_significant)
  )
```

### PICRUST using KEGG 
```{r}
### PICRUSt2 using KEGG

# Read PICRUSt2 KO table
ko <- read_tsv(
  "picrust2_output/KO_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_unstrat.tsv.gz",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

names(ko)[1] <- "KO"

ko <- ko %>%
  mutate(
    KO = as.character(KO),
    KO = sub("^ko:", "", KO)
  )

# Sample metadata
meta_kegg <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_asv)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  select(
    sample,
    turtle_ID,
    sample_type,
    everything()
  )

meta_kegg$sample_type <- factor(
  meta_kegg$sample_type,
  levels = c("colon", "cloaca")
)

# Check sample IDs
ko_sample_ids <- names(ko)[-1]

stopifnot(
  setequal(
    ko_sample_ids,
    sample_names(phy_asv)
  )
)

# Download KEGG BRITE KO hierarchy
brite_raw <- KEGGREST::keggGet(
  "br:ko00001"
)

brite_txt <- unlist(
  strsplit(
    brite_raw,
    split = "\n",
    fixed = TRUE
  )
)

# Parse KEGG hierarchy
current_L1 <- NA_character_
current_L2 <- NA_character_
current_L3 <- NA_character_

mapping_list <- list()
counter <- 1

for (line in brite_txt) {

  line_trim <- trimws(line)

  if (grepl("^A\\d+", line_trim)) {

    current_L1 <- sub(
      "^A\\d+\\s+",
      "",
      line_trim
    )

  } else if (grepl("^B\\s+\\d+", line_trim)) {

    current_L2 <- sub(
      "^B\\s+\\d+\\s+",
      "",
      line_trim
    )

  } else if (grepl("^C\\s+\\d+", line_trim)) {

    current_L3 <- sub(
      "^C\\s+\\d+\\s+",
      "",
      line_trim
    )

    current_L3 <- sub(
      "\\s+\\[PATH:.*\\]$",
      "",
      current_L3
    )

  } else if (grepl("^D\\s+K\\d{5}", line_trim)) {

    ko_id <- stringr::str_extract(
      line_trim,
      "K\\d{5}"
    )

    if (!is.na(ko_id)) {

      mapping_list[[counter]] <- data.frame(
        KO = ko_id,
        KEGG_Level1 = current_L1,
        KEGG_Level2 = current_L2,
        KEGG_Level3 = current_L3,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      counter <- counter + 1
    }
  }
}

kegg_map_clean <- dplyr::bind_rows(mapping_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(KO),
    !is.na(KEGG_Level1),
    !is.na(KEGG_Level2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

dir.create(
  "picrust2_results/KEGG",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  kegg_map_clean,
  "picrust2_results/KEGG/KO_to_KEGG_hierarchy.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Mapping coverage
predicted_kos <- unique(ko$KO)
mapped_kos <- intersect(
  predicted_kos,
  kegg_map_clean$KO
)

mapping_summary <- data.frame(
  predicted_KOs = length(predicted_kos),
  mapped_KOs = length(mapped_kos),
  mapping_percent = round(
    100 * length(mapped_kos) / length(predicted_kos),
    2
  ),
  unmapped_KOs = length(
    setdiff(
      predicted_kos,
      kegg_map_clean$KO
    )
  )
)

print(mapping_summary)

# Long-form KO table
ko_long <- ko %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -KO,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "predicted_KO_abundance"
  )

# Join KEGG hierarchy
ko_annotated <- ko_long %>%
  inner_join(
    kegg_map_clean,
    by = "KO"
  )

# Collapse to KEGG Levels 1, 2 and 3
kegg_L1 <- ko_annotated %>%
  group_by(
    sample,
    KEGG_Level1
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    predicted_abundance = sum(
      predicted_KO_abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kegg_L2 <- ko_annotated %>%
  group_by(
    sample,
    KEGG_Level1,
    KEGG_Level2
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    predicted_abundance = sum(
      predicted_KO_abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kegg_L3 <- ko_annotated %>%
  group_by(
    sample,
    KEGG_Level1,
    KEGG_Level2,
    KEGG_Level3
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    predicted_abundance = sum(
      predicted_KO_abundance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Convert to relative abundance within sample
kegg_L1_rel <- kegg_L1 %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(
    relative_abundance =
      predicted_abundance /
      sum(predicted_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    meta_kegg,
    by = "sample"
  )

kegg_L2_rel <- kegg_L2 %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(
    relative_abundance =
      predicted_abundance /
      sum(predicted_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    meta_kegg,
    by = "sample"
  )

kegg_L3_rel <- kegg_L3 %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(
    relative_abundance =
      predicted_abundance /
      sum(predicted_abundance, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    meta_kegg,
    by = "sample"
  )

# Paired Wilcoxon function
paired_kegg_test <- function(
  df,
  category_col
) {

  categories <- unique(
    df[[category_col]]
  )

  result_list <- vector(
    "list",
    length(categories)
  )

  for (i in seq_along(categories)) {

    cat_i <- categories[i]

    tmp <- df %>%
      filter(
        .data[[category_col]] == cat_i
      ) %>%
      select(
        turtle_ID,
        sample_type,
        relative_abundance
      ) %>%
      group_by(
        turtle_ID,
        sample_type
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        relative_abundance = sum(
          relative_abundance,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = sample_type,
        values_from = relative_abundance
      )

    if (
      !all(
        c("colon", "cloaca") %in% names(tmp)
      )
    ) {
      next
    }

    tmp <- tmp %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(colon),
        !is.na(cloaca)
      )

    if (nrow(tmp) < 2) {
      next
    }

    wt <- wilcox.test(
      tmp$colon,
      tmp$cloaca,
      paired = TRUE,
      exact = FALSE
    )

    paired_diff <- tmp$colon - tmp$cloaca

    result_list[[i]] <- tibble(
      category = cat_i,
      n_pairs = nrow(tmp),
      mean_colon = mean(
        tmp$colon,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      mean_cloaca = mean(
        tmp$cloaca,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      median_colon = median(
        tmp$colon,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      median_cloaca = median(
        tmp$cloaca,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      median_paired_difference = median(
        paired_diff,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      p_value = wt$p.value
    )
  }

  results <- bind_rows(result_list)

  if (nrow(results) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No KEGG categories produced complete colon-cloaca pairs."
    )
  }

  results %>%
    mutate(
      q_value = p.adjust(
        p_value,
        method = "BH"
      ),
      associated_group = case_when(
        q_value < 0.05 &
          median_paired_difference > 0 ~
          "Colon",

        q_value < 0.05 &
          median_paired_difference < 0 ~
          "Cloaca",

        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(q_value)
}

# KEGG Level 1
kegg_L1_results <- paired_kegg_test(
  kegg_L1_rel,
  "KEGG_Level1"
)

# KEGG Level 2
kegg_L2_results <- paired_kegg_test(
  kegg_L2_rel,
  "KEGG_Level2"
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    KEGG_Level2 = category
  )

L2_parent <- kegg_map_clean %>%
  select(
    KEGG_Level1,
    KEGG_Level2
  ) %>%
  distinct()

kegg_L2_results <- kegg_L2_results %>%
  left_join(
    L2_parent,
    by = "KEGG_Level2"
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    KEGG_Level1,
    KEGG_Level2
  )

# Add paired rank-biserial effect sizes
add_paired_effect_size <- function(
  results_df,
  abundance_df,
  category_col
) {

  categories <- results_df[[category_col]]

  effect_list <- lapply(
    categories,
    function(cat_i) {

      tmp <- abundance_df %>%
        filter(
          .data[[category_col]] == cat_i
        ) %>%
        select(
          turtle_ID,
          sample_type,
          relative_abundance
        ) %>%
        group_by(
          turtle_ID,
          sample_type
        ) %>%
        summarise(
          relative_abundance = sum(
            relative_abundance,
            na.rm = TRUE
          ),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        pivot_wider(
          names_from = sample_type,
          values_from = relative_abundance
        ) %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(colon),
          !is.na(cloaca)
        )

      if (nrow(tmp) < 2) {

        return(
          tibble(
            !!category_col := cat_i,
            rank_biserial = NA_real_,
            rb_CI_low = NA_real_,
            rb_CI_high = NA_real_
          )
        )
      }

      rb <- effectsize::rank_biserial(
        tmp$colon,
        tmp$cloaca,
        paired = TRUE,
        ci = 0.95
      )

      rb_df <- as.data.frame(rb)

      effect_col <- names(rb_df)[
        grepl(
          "r_rank_biserial|rank_biserial|rb",
          names(rb_df),
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )
      ][1]

      low_col <- names(rb_df)[
        grepl(
          "CI_low|CI.low",
          names(rb_df),
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )
      ][1]

      high_col <- names(rb_df)[
        grepl(
          "CI_high|CI.high",
          names(rb_df),
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )
      ][1]

      tibble(
        !!category_col := cat_i,

        rank_biserial =
          as.numeric(
            rb_df[[effect_col]][1]
          ),

        rb_CI_low =
          if (!is.na(low_col))
            as.numeric(
              rb_df[[low_col]][1]
            )
          else
            NA_real_,

        rb_CI_high =
          if (!is.na(high_col))
            as.numeric(
              rb_df[[high_col]][1]
            )
          else
            NA_real_
      )
    }
  )

  effect_table <- bind_rows(
    effect_list
  )

  results_df %>%
    left_join(
      effect_table,
      by = category_col
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      abs_rank_biserial =
        abs(rank_biserial),

      effect_direction =
        case_when(
          rank_biserial > 0 ~ "Colon",
          rank_biserial < 0 ~ "Cloaca",
          TRUE ~ "No direction"
        ),

      high_effect =
        q_value < 0.05 &
        abs_rank_biserial >= 0.50
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(abs_rank_biserial)
    )
}

# Level 2 overview
kegg_L2_overview <- kegg_L2_effects %>%
  mutate(
    abs_rank_biserial =
      abs(rank_biserial),

    abs_median_difference =
      abs(median_paired_difference),

    direction =
      case_when(
        median_paired_difference > 0 ~ "Colon",
        median_paired_difference < 0 ~ "Cloaca",
        TRUE ~ "No difference"
      ),

    significant_FDR =
      q_value < 0.05
  ) %>%
  arrange(q_value)

# Prepare Level 3 prioritization
kegg_L3_prioritized <- kegg_L3_effects %>%
  mutate(
    abs_rank_biserial =
      abs(rank_biserial),

    abs_median_difference =
      abs(median_paired_difference),

    direction =
      case_when(
        median_paired_difference > 0 ~ "Colon",
        median_paired_difference < 0 ~ "Cloaca",
        TRUE ~ "No difference"
      ),

    significant_FDR =
      q_value < 0.05,

    q_for_score =
      pmax(
        q_value,
        .Machine$double.xmin
      ),

    neg_log10_q =
      -log10(q_for_score)
  )

# Rank FDR-significant Level 3 pathways
kegg_L3_sig_for_ranking <- kegg_L3_prioritized %>%
  filter(
    significant_FDR,
    !is.na(rank_biserial),
    !is.na(median_paired_difference)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    score_FDR =
      percent_rank(
        neg_log10_q
      ),

    score_effect =
      percent_rank(
        abs_rank_biserial
      ),

    score_magnitude =
      percent_rank(
        abs_median_difference
      )
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    priority_score =
      mean(
        c(
          score_FDR,
          score_effect,
          score_magnitude
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(
    desc(priority_score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    global_priority_rank =
      row_number()
  )

# Top 50 globally
kegg_L3_top50_global <- kegg_L3_sig_for_ranking %>%
  slice_head(
    n = 50
  )

# Rank pathways within each Level 2 category
kegg_L3_within_L2 <- kegg_L3_sig_for_ranking %>%
  group_by(
    KEGG_Level1,
    KEGG_Level2
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(priority_score),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_within_Level2 =
      row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

kegg_L3_top5_per_L2 <- kegg_L3_within_L2 %>%
  filter(
    rank_within_Level2 <= 5
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    KEGG_Level1,
    KEGG_Level2,
    rank_within_Level2
  )

# Metabolism-only Level 3 results
kegg_L3_metabolism <- kegg_L3_sig_for_ranking %>%
  filter(
    KEGG_Level1 == "Metabolism"
  ) %>%

    desc(priority_score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metabolism_priority_rank =
      row_number()
  )

kegg_L3_metabolism_top5_per_L2 <- kegg_L3_metabolism %>%
  group_by(
    KEGG_Level2
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(priority_score),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_within_Level2 =
      row_number()
  ) %>%
  filter(
    rank_within_Level2 <= 5
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(
    KEGG_Level2,
    rank_within_Level2
  )

# Predefined gut-relevant pathways

  filter(

  ) %>%
  left_join(

      ) %>%

  )

# Level 2 metabolism overview
```

```{r}
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = rb_CI_low,
      xmax = rb_CI_high
    ),
    height = 0.18,
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = direction
    ),
    size = 2.6
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-1, 1),
    breaks = seq(
      -1,
      1,
      by = 0.5
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Paired rank-biserial correlation\n← Cloaca-associated     Colon-associated →",
    y = NULL,
    shape = NULL,
    title = "B  Selected predicted KEGG Level 3 pathways"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 10
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 8.5
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Combine panels
p_kegg_final <-
  p_kegg_A /
  p_kegg_B +
  patchwork::plot_layout(
    heights = c(
      1.7,
      1
    )
  ) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "PICRUSt2-predicted functional differences between colonic and cloacal bacterial communities",
    subtitle = "KEGG functional profiles inferred from 16S rRNA gene amplicon data"
  )

print(
  p_kegg_final
)

# Save
dir.create(
  "picrust2_figures/KEGG/final",
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  "picrust2_figures/KEGG/final/KEGG_candidate_functional_figure.pdf",
  p_kegg_final,
  width = 11,
  height = 13
)

ggsave(
  "picrust2_figures/KEGG/final/KEGG_candidate_functional_figure.png",
  p_kegg_final,
  width = 11,
  height = 13,
  dpi = 600
)
```
